overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Seattle 2-Person Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, providing a serene escape with its natural Canadian Hemlock wood construction and clear tempered glass door. Featuring 6 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels, it delivers soothing heat to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Enhance your experience with the interior chromotherapy lighting system and built-in Bluetooth speakers, creating a personalized, spa-like atmosphere.
